edits.before: Q-poke the contacts — the stack passive means your carry's autos are CC in progress.
edits.after: His charged Arcanopulse (750 range) outranges your whole kit from level 1.

edits.before: Concussive trades begin: three hits and the stun votes; trade in stack windows.
edits.after: The Eye of Destruction (W) slow zone makes his poke unmissable well beyond your engage.

edits.before: Full kit: E eats their poke and W teleports the peel — the lane plays through your shield.
edits.after: Full Q+W+E lets him bully the lane freely at level 3.

edits.before: Stack the margins — every traded auto is a quarter-stun; their math hates it.
edits.after: Through 4-5 he permanently zones you and your ADC with artillery poke.

edits.before: Glacial Fissure online — the line knockup starts dives and ends theirs.
edits.after: His level 6 triple-bolt Rite of the Arcane threatens kills from off-screen.

edits.before: First item: the wall hardens and the stack windows chain into kills.
edits.after: First-item mana and AP let him poke endlessly with no answer from you.

edits.before: Late Braum is the wall: E their teamfight's biggest cast, R their engage, stun whoever touches the carry.
edits.after: By 2+ items you flank and stun the immobile, escape-less Xerath.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and the artillery never converts. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Unbreakable banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Shocking Orb (E) is down 11-13s by rank — his only CC; dodge it and the artillery rotation never converts. - Rite of the Arcane (R) is 130/115/100s and a full channel — any hard CC, including your point-click Concussive Blows stun, cancels it outright. - Save Unbreakable (E) for the Q, not routine chip.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: His Arcanopulse charges before it fires — trade with your ADC only in the window right after it lands, not while he's holding it.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Xerath's Q/W both outrange Winter's Bite — walking up to trade just eats free poke for nothing back.
